## Rosetta — the Sisterhooves Social judge

Rosetta is a minor *Friendship Is Magic* Earth-pony mare best remembered as the judge/registration pony who enforces fair play in **“Brotherhooves Social.”** She has a pale cream-yellow coat, lilac-pink mane and tail, muted green eyes, and a flower-with-two-leaves cutie mark. She is distinct from Rose/Roseluck, the raspberry-maned florist. Her identified appearances are **“Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17)**, Rarity’s derby flashback in **“The Cart Before the Ponies” (S6E14)**, and Ponyville Hospital in **“Where the Apple Lies” (S6E23)**. [Character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mar﻿es).

**Naming and voice:** “Rosetta” is a fan/wiki identification, not a verified name spoken on screen. Image-tag aliases include **Rosebud** and **Registration Pony** ([tag record](https://twibooru.org/tags/rosetta)). The episode credits call her **Registration Pony**, voiced in English by **Tabitha St. Germain** ([season-five credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_five)). She **does speak**, especially when judging the final race; no secret identity or alter ego is documented.

## Important moments

[Official full episode: “Brotherhooves Social”](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ngtTehVTz4). Exact scene timestamps could not be verified.

- **Allows an unconventional pair** — *“Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17).* Big Mac, disguised as “Orchard Blossom,” is allowed to enter with Apple Bloom because the contest does not strictly require biological sisters.
- **Rules for sportsponyship, not gender** — *“Brotherhooves Social” (S5E17).* Rosetta’s credited role, Registration Pony, explains that the judges knew Big Mac was a stallion; she disqualifies the pair for knocking down competitors, changing the result in favor of Rainbow Dash and Scootaloo ([episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Brotherhooves_Social)).
